name: Frame Window Counter
description: Frame Window Counter (FB-style) with physics-based Auto mode, Manual marker mode, crisp world-space click circles, classic & custom bell sounds, and native GD UI.

enabled.name: Enable Mod
enabled.description: Toggle the entire Frame Window Counter mod.

mode.name: Counter Mode
mode.description: Auto (live physics window estimation) or Manual (marker playback).

ref-fps.name: Reference FPS
ref-fps.description: Target FPS scale for frame counts (e.g. 60, 240, 360, 6000).

auto-tps-adapt.name: Adapt to Live TPS
auto-tps-adapt.description: Measure live physics TPS from game delta time (bot & speedhack safe).

show-circles.name: Show Click Circles
show-circles.description: Spawn color-coded rings at every click position in the level.

show-circle-label.name: Show Frame Label on Circle
show-circle-label.description: Display the frame window text above each click ring.

show-hud.name: Show Bottom-Left HUD
show-hud.description: Display the bottom-left frame counter overlay.

show-percentages.name: Show Percentages in HUD
show-percentages.description: Display Frame Perfect % and estimated Pass Probability %.

show-special-stats.name: Show S-Frames / Swifts / Multiclicks
show-special-stats.description: Show special click counters in the HUD.

detect-swifts.name: Detect Swift Clicks
detect-swifts.description: Enable Swift click detection on quick press-release inputs.

detect-multiclicks.name: Detect Multiclicks
detect-multiclicks.description: Enable Multiclick tagging on rapid consecutive clicks.

show-banner.name: Show Intro Banner
show-banner.description: Show the level info & legend banner at the start of an attempt.

banner-duration.name: Banner Duration (sec)
banner-duration.description: How long the intro banner stays visible in game seconds.

banner-comment.name: Banner Comment
banner-comment.description: Optional comment shown next to the level name (leave empty to hide).

show-raw-precision.name: Show Precision Line
show-raw-precision.description: Show the optional precision text line inside the intro banner.

raw-precision-text.name: Precision Text
raw-precision-text.description: Optional precision text in the intro banner (leave empty to hide).

sound-enabled.name: Enable Bell Sounds
sound-enabled.description: Play a bell sound on clicks.

sound-preset.name: Bell Sound
sound-preset.description: Choose built-in bell or custom sound file.

custom-sound-file.name: Custom Sound File
custom-sound-file.description: Filename inside the mod sounds folder (or full path to .wav/.mp3/.ogg).

sound-pitch.name: Bell Base Pitch
sound-pitch.description: Base pitch multiplier for bell sounds.

dynamic-pitch.name: Auto Pitch by Difficulty
dynamic-pitch.description: Raise pitch automatically on tighter frame windows.

capture-to-manual.name: Capture Clicks to Manual List
capture-to-manual.description: Record clicks from your run/bot into the Manual Markers list.
